question: Should OpenClaw add this custom Android Appearance language picker now, or require a different Android per-app-language direction before merge?
rationale: The code is plausible and proven, but it adds a new persisted user preference and locale precedence behavior, which automation should not accept without Android product intent.

options.title: Accept after conflict refresh
options.body: Resolve the i18n inventory conflict, rerun the Android/i18n checks, and proceed with the in-app selector if Android owners accept this product surface.

options.title: Require platform-native direction
options.body: Ask for a narrower redesign around Android/AppCompat per-app language integration before adding a custom selector and preference.

options.title: Decline Android-specific selector
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers do not want a separate Android language setting beyond system/device behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept after conflict refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve the i18n inventory conflict, rerun the Android/i18n checks, and proceed with the in-app selector if Android owners accept this product surface.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the recent Android settings and preference surfaces that define the right product boundary for this selector.
